# MM-P1-L2-HT03-S1 - Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3
Revision: Rev E  
Supersedes: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Scope
This procedure covers lubrication and fluid handling for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) in P1, line P1-L2. It defines approved lubricant part number, quench delay requirement, tools required, stepwise procedure for application and inspection, and acceptance criteria. Refer to SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-02, and SOP-P1-L2-03 for related operational and safety procedures.

Tools
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-652
- Clean lint-free wipes
- Approved dispensing container compatible with CFW-LUB-652
- PPE as required by SOP-P1-L2-02

Procedure
1. Verify equipment is in a safe state per SOP-P1-L2-01 and SOP-P1-L2-03. Confirm work area and PPE.
2. Inspect dispensing container and confirm label matches CFW-LUB-652. Use only CFW-LUB-652 for all lubrication tasks on EQ-P1-L2-HT03.
3. Clean application points with lint-free wipes to remove contaminants prior to lubrication.
4. Apply lubricant sparingly to bearings and sliding interfaces identified in the equipment maintenance diagram. Remove excess immediately to prevent accumulation.
5. For quench operations, ensure the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds. Do not exceed this quench delay maximum.
6. Record lubricant part number applied and any deviations in the maintenance log. Follow escalation in SOP-P1-L2-03 if discrepancies are found.

Acceptance criteria
- Lubricant applied is CFW-LUB-652 with no evidence of cross-contamination.
- Application points are clean, dry except for the intended lubricant film, and free of excess buildup.
- Quench operations meet the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) of 24 seconds.
- Maintenance log entries completed and consistent with SOP-P1-L2-01 and SOP-P1-L2-02.
